title: Quarterly roadmap choreography: Signal Thermometer & hosted-API + model-catalog sync
creator: Ava Patel
description: Create a repeatable quarterly 'choreography' for aligning Hosted API product roadmap and model catalog initiatives with OKRs, capacity signals, and release windows. Deliverables: Signal Thermometer rubric (go/no-go thresholds), a choreography board template for cross-functional checkpoints, prioritized initiative mapping to OKRs, and a lightweight escalation/runbook for late-breaking model swaps. This ticket captures planning, stakeholder feedback, and first-run execution guidance for Q2 planning.
acceptance_criteria: Published Signal Thermometer doc with explicit thresholds (green/yellow/red) for capacity, quality regressions, and cost delta
Choreography board template (Confluence) with checkpoints, owners, and required artifacts per checkpoint
OKR mapping spreadsheet populated for top 12 hosted-api + model-catalog initiatives
Runbook for emergency model substitution drafted and reviewed by runtime/ops
Cross-functional alignment workshop executed and feedback captured in comments
tasks: Draft Signal Thermometer and share with Eng/Research for threshold calibration
Create choreography board in Confluence and pre-populate first-quarter checkpoints
Collect capacity/benchmarks from infra (ENG-2145) and update thermometer values
Publish final playbook and notify stakeholders with read/ack tracking
comments: 2026-02-20 Ava Patel: Kickoff — framing doc posted (confluence.redwood.internal/roadmap-choreo). Goal: a single lightweight artifact teams can use to coordinate hosted API releases + model catalog rotations.

2026-02-25 Diego Morales: Spoke with infra SREs — current dedicated cluster margins are ~18% at baseline; we'll treat <12% as yellow and <6% as red by default. Added ENG-2145 as dependency to pull time-series capacity metrics.
2026-03-01 Lina Park (Design): Reviewed choreography board UI — asked for a compact view for execs and an expanded view for engineers. We'll ship both; exec view is required for acceptance criteria.

2026-03-04 Emma Chen (Research): Proposed adding a quality-signal weight to the thermometer that factors in eval regression magnitude (AUC drop) and prompt cohort exposure. Shared prototype eval dashboard: drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EvalProto

2026-03-06 Diego Morales: Workshop #1 notes — consensus on thresholds, but trade-off table required for model-variant substitution (latency vs cost vs quality). Action: PM to draft decision thermometer mapping by 3/10.

2026-03-09 Ava Patel: Draft published (confluence.redwood.internal/signal-thermometer) — requested review from runtime, ops, and legal. Added two example scenarios: holiday surge and model CVE fallback.

2026-03-10 Runtime lead (Marcus Lee): Reviewed and suggested a conservative fallback lane: use quantized variant + prefix-KV cache warmup before full model swap. Added runtime-1.21 rollout note to playbook.

2026-03-11 Diego Morales: Updated choreography board with checkpoints: 1) Intake & OKR mapping, 2) Capacity signal validation, 3) Canary windows & rollback gates, 4) Post-release health check. Assigned owners for each checkpoint.

2026-03-12 Ava Patel: Workshop #2 scheduled for 2026-03-15 to run a dry-run using two hypothetical initiatives (new chat endpoint + embedding model rotation). Next steps: finalize playbook and publish to /team-playbooks by 3/22.
